name: MPSC Combined Group B & C (Maharashtra CGL)
notes: Single bilingual (Marathi/English) paper: 100 compulsory MCQs, 4 options each, 100 marks, 1 hour; a quarter of a question's marks deducted per wrong answer (2023 booklet, instruction 7). Bank: the 2023 Combined Prelim, series A, 98 questions whose answers match the official final key (Q19 and Q74 were cancelled).
